ns2:section.sectionText: The class meets twice per week: once on Tuesdays, and a second time to attend performances and/or exhibitions at Krannert Center for the Performing Arts and/or Krannert Art Museum. Event dates and times will vary. Students must be able to commit to attending the events on the syllabus. Admission to all events will be provided without charge to students enrolled in the course. The class meets at Krannert Center, located at 500 S. Goodwin Avenue in Urbana. Directions to the classroom: Take the elevator to Level 2 (Production) and walk down the hallway, towards the rehearsal rooms. Make a left, and (at the end of the hallway), take the stairs on the right up to the Lyric Theatre offices. At the top of the stairs, Ensemble A (4-506) will be the first classroom on the left.
